title: GATE Agent Bill of Materials (ABOM)
description: Authoritative manifest for an agent version: model, prompt bundle, tool schema set, invariant bundle, policy bundle. v1.3 adds current_baseline_hash so the C19 baseline is tied to the ABOM version. v1.4 adds output_classification_bundle_hash so the C20 bundle in force for this agent is recorded, and auto_enrolment_eligible so the C17 fast-path eligibility is an ABOM property rather than a per-deployment policy lookup.

abom_hash.description: Stable hash over the canonicalised ABOM contents. Recorded in policy decisions, replay traces, and C19 baselines.

config.description: Temperature, top_p, max_tokens, seed, etc. Pinned for replay.

current_baseline_hash.description: Hash of the active C19 behavioural baseline for this ABOM. Required at bounded and high-privilege tiers per Check18. Updates trigger the C19 re-baselining workflow.

memory_quality_bundle_hash.description: Hash of the active C18 quality bundle in force for this agent. Recorded in every quality_decision event.

output_classification_bundle_hash.description: Hash of the active C20 output classification bundle for this agent. Recorded in every gate.output.classification event via bundle_hash. Required at bounded and high-privilege tiers per Check20; presence enforcement is at the conformance layer, not the schema.

auto_enrolment_eligible.description: True when this agent's manifest declares eligibility for the C17 automated enrolment fast-path. Default false (matching the precedent set by audit_ledger_event.algorithm and behavioural_baseline.algorithm). Consumers treat absence as false. The C17 policy verifies fast-path eligibility on each evaluation regardless of this flag; the flag declares the operator's intent for this ABOM version, not the runtime decision.
